name: easyNIS
description:
Pipe-friendly tools for opening annual Healthcare Cost and
Utilization Project National Inpatient Sample Parquet files, flagging
diagnosis and procedure codes, applying HCUP 'CCSR' mappings, adding
experimental comorbidity indicators and indices, preparing designs and
weights with the
'survey' package, applying supported HCUP labels, adjusting charges and
costs, and reviewing disclosure risks. The Agency for Healthcare Research
and Quality provides information on the NIS and how to obtain it at
<https://hcup-us.ahrq.gov/nisoverview.jsp>. Experimental methods and
annual-layout assumptions are not independently verified or scientifically
approved.
